34	    def tick_no_progress(self) -> None:
35	        """진전 없는 tick을 기록하고 stall 레벨을 에스컬레이션한다."""
36	        self.consecutive_no_progress_ticks += 1
37	        n = self.consecutive_no_progress_ticks
38	        if n >= self.CHECKPOINT_ONLY_THRESHOLD:
39	            self.watchdog_level = "CHECKPOINT_ONLY"
40	        elif n >= self.STALL_3_THRESHOLD:
41	            self.watchdog_level = "STALL_3"
42	        elif n >= self.STALL_2_THRESHOLD:
43	            self.watchdog_level = "STALL_2"
44	        elif n >= self.STALL_1_THRESHOLD:

47	    def tick_progress(self, tick_id: str) -> None:

50	        self.consecutive_no_progress_ticks = 0
51	        self.watchdog_level = "OK"

54	    def increment_lineage(self, lineage_id: str) -> int:
55	        """lineage 재시도 횟수를 증분하고 현재 횟수를 반환한다."""
56	        entry = self.lineage_counters.setdefault(lineage_id, {"level": 0, "attempts": 0})
57	        entry["attempts"] += 1
58	        return entry["attempts"]

60	    def update_lineage_level(self, lineage_id: str, level: int, outcome: str) -> None:
61	        """lineage 레벨과 결과를 갱신한다 (WatchdogState 내 빠른 조회용)."""
62	        entry = self.lineage_counters.setdefault(lineage_id, {"level": 0, "attempts": 0})
63	        entry["level"] = level
64	        entry["last_outcome"] = outcome

66	    def is_lineage_maxed(self, lineage_id: str, max_attempts: int = 20) -> bool:
67	        """lineage 상한 도달 여부 반환. lineage_ledger와 이중 체크용."""
68	        entry = self.lineage_counters.get(lineage_id)
69	        if entry is None:
70	            return False
71	        return entry.get("attempts", 0) >= max_attempts or entry.get("level", 0) > 5

73	    def degrade_lineage(self, lineage_id: str) -> None:
74	        """lineage 상한 도달 시 degrade 플래그 설정. attempts를 max+1로 고정."""
75	        entry = self.lineage_counters.setdefault(lineage_id, {"level": 0, "attempts": 0})
76	        entry["degraded"] = True
77	        if entry.get("attempts", 0) < 20:
78	            entry["attempts"] = 20
